title: Untitled (Framed Perforated Sheet)
description: Framed white perforated sheet mounted at center, surrounded by dense collage incorporating targets, cassette tapes, an American football, warplane silhouettes, chess pieces, and text fragment reading 'in the driver's seat.' Bottom edge bears handwritten inscription 'XXXIII DBS' with colorful tape strips and concentric-ring targets throughout the border.
composition: framed inset centered on collaged border
